naming_note: closure50 is an internal storage identifier at the same level as python150 / hard50 / prime / v2. It does not define a paper-facing difficulty tier or benchmark name.

recipe.behavior_clauses: 4-5 semantic clauses + 1 API-surface clause + 1 isolation clause
recipe.rationale: hard3 median reference is 101 LOC with pass-conditioned copy fraction 0.086: agents cannot copy their way through and must re-implement precise semantics. Hard-50 used large slices (copy 0.66) and saturated at Flash 49/50.
branch_types: exception branch and exception type, including which entry point raises
state transition order and return-value ordering
forbidden: adding hidden tests after calibration to lower the score
hidden tests exercising undeclared API (blocking L2_C1_SURFACE)
over-strict match= regexes or vague contracts
raising difficulty by picking a bigger repo or a bigger slice
upstream overlap with the existing 200 tasks

calibration.protocol: OpenHands Official Main, same agent/eval image as freeze v2

baselines.oracle: public + hidden pass, stable over N=3
baselines.naive: public may pass, hidden must fail
baselines.copy_all: may pass functionally, RRES clearly worse than reference

calibration.note: Hard-50 calibrated at Flash 29/50 during construction but scored 49/50 on freeze v2 Official Main. Calibration must therefore reuse the Main image and profile, not a separate construction-time run.

reject: requires network, services, browsers or credentials
